cloud.title: Connect to Turzi Cloud
cloud.description: Paste the enrollment token generated in the Turzi Community Manager. The bridge will be provisioned automatically.

data_description.enrollment_token: Single-use token (TRZ-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) generated for this home.
data_description.api_base_url: Only change this when connecting to a self-hosted Turzi backend.

manual.title: MQTT Broker Configuration
manual.description: Configure the connection to your own MQTT broker (self-hosted / local mode).

data_description.broker: The hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker.
data_description.port: The port number of your MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.house_id: A unique identifier for this house (used in MQTT topic prefixes).
data_description.use_tls: Enable TLS encryption for the MQTT connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MQTT Broker
reconfigure.description: Update the MQTT broker connection settings.

data_description.broker: The hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker.
data_description.port: The port number of your MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.house_id: A unique identifier for this house (used in MQTT topic prefixes).
data_description.use_tls: Enable TLS encryption for the MQTT connection.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Please check your settings and network.
error.token_invalid: This enrollment token is unknown, expired, or already used. Generate a new one in the Turzi Community Manager.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.home_not_ready: This home is not ready for enrollment yet — ask your community manager to configure its smart home connection.

abort.already_configured: This house ID is already configured.

token_revoked.title: Turzi Cloud connection revoked
token_revoked.description: This bridge was unlinked from Turzi Cloud. Ask your community manager for a new enrollment token, then re-add the integration.

init.title: Exposure & privacy
init.description: Choose which entities are published to the Turzi app. Entities in the privacy blocklist are never published, in any mode — not even when exposure is managed remotely.

data_description.included_domains: ALL entities in these domains are published automatically.
data_description.exposed_entities: Individual entities published IN ADDITION to the included domains (e.g. a specific sensor).
data_description.auto_add_new: New entities in included domains are exposed automatically.
data_description.never_expose: These entities are never published, overriding every other setting. Survives re-enrollment.
